description: Internet-Facing ALB Without AWS WAF Is Open to the Whole Internet
rationale: No AWS WAF web ACL is associated with this internet-facing Application Load Balancer (wafv2:GetWebACLForResource) and its security groups allow a listener port from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. Requests therefore reach the application without AWS WAF inspection, and any external WAF/CDN in front of it can be bypassed by connecting to the ALB address directly. ALBs whose listener ports only accept CloudFront's origin-facing prefix list or catalogued CDN/WAF proxy ranges are reported as external_waf_likely and are not flagged; denied lookups or unresolved security groups are UNKNOWN.
remediation: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB, or put it behind CloudFront/an external WAF and restrict the security group to that proxy (CloudFront managed prefix list or the provider's published ranges), optionally with a secret origin header checked by a listener rule.
